cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Interpret the Custom
cards.instruction: Ask them to apply an ambiguous custom where the wording is unclear. Treat their interpretation as the real test of loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our gardening club supports members 'where possible.' Will you sign my appeal against losing my allotment?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That could just mean wishing you luck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fill in the address. You only need to sign; is that still outside 'possible'?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Some members want my name kept off it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll talk to them. Is signing beside me still 'possible'?

reason: A takes paperwork and then the dissenters as burdens to keep the signer cooperative; repeated wording tests actual allegiance rather than explaining a theme.
